active_lessons.future_rule: As ChatGPT PM, do not stop after selecting the best individual trade. After choosing a core idea, explicitly construct the portfolio: scan independent positive-EV opportunities, identify the main adverse scenario for the existing book, test complementary or offsetting trades, avoid duplicated macro beta, and justify why each strong candidate is added or rejected. A one-position book is valid only after this portfolio pass.

research_supplement.summary: Energy risk stays front and center as Hormuz attacks target ship engine rooms, leaving oil buffers uncomfortably thin even as LNG transits rebound. Brent sits near 109 and WTI above 101, feeding a rising Canadian prima-pressure read alongside firm IPPI ex-energy. U.S. rates are mixed: SOFR is 3.88%, the 10-year is 5.12% after a modest daily dip tied to soft housing, yet the policy debate still allows for more tightening. Treasury supply continues to lean on selective buyers…
